checks.title: Public numeric IDs are unique per entity
Denormalized parent fields match canonical parents
Normalized names are unique within a parent unless reviewed
Coordinates are paired and within WGS84 ranges
Every null or coverage gap is classified
Published supplemental QIDs are valid, unique, and verified
Timezone IDs and observed static offsets are valid
Country polygon outliers are corrected or explicitly classified
State coordinates are verified, derived, or explicitly excepted
Raw, optimized, shard, npm, and manifest artifacts match by hash
Exceptions have an owner, rationale, evidence, and future expiry

knownIssues.rationale: Chiayi and Hsinchu each intentionally have separate city and county subdivisions with the same normalized display name and distinct ISO-style subdivision codes.
Every remaining major city point outlier is mapped to a reviewed political, hierarchy, territorial-claim, or Natural Earth reference-scale rule; no coordinate defect remains unresolved.

These subdivisions lack a defensible matched Admin-1 polygon or validated source point, or carry a documented hierarchy/worldview exception; the records publish explicit unavailable/exception metadata.
